newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-STEAUA BUCHAREST VS WIDZEW LODZ TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STEAUA BUCHAREST VS WIDZEW LODZ TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup match between Steaua Bucharest of Romania and Widzew Lodz of Poland in Group B of the Champions' League:

Steaua Bucharest - 23-Bogdan Stelea, 14-Tudorel Zamfirescu, 15-Marius Baciu, 4-Tiberiu Csik, 2-Iulian Filipescu, 8-Damian Militaru, 22-Denis Serban, 3-Roland Nagy, 9-Augustin Calin, 7-Marius Lacatus, 11-Sabin Ilie. Substitutes: 12-Daniel Gherasim, 16-Ilie Miu, 17-Laurentiu Rosu, 18-Cristain Ciocoiu, 19-Ioan Nemtanu.

Widzew Lodz - 1-Maciej Szczesny, 5-Pawel Wojtala, 14-Marek Bajor, 3-Tomasz Lapinski, 15-Daniel Bogusz, 2-Miroslaw Szymkowiak, 7-Radoslaw Michalski, 12-Slawomir Majak, 18-Pawel Miaszkiewicz, 6-Marek Citko, 8-Jacek Dembinski. Substitutes: 21-Tomasz Muchinski, 11-Rafal Siadaczka, 13-Piotr Szarpak, 16-Marcin Zajac
